race.comment: SAMAKA (1) is a good type resuming. Strong through the line with the 58.5kg for a close up third to Lady Invictus over 1100m at Warwick Farm in a Super Maiden on June 3. Primed with the two good trials and gets his chance from the good draw. ZOUSARI (6) comes here with a fitness edge over most of these and gets a much better set-up today. Snagged back from the draw and was never in contention when seventh over 1400m at Kembla Grange. Will race much closer from the draw and has genuine top three claims. STAR HALF (3) sat on the good tempo first up and showed plenty of fight with a narrow second over 1200m at Wyong. Fitter now and has the class to overcome the draw. DWIGHT (5) excellent return when he sat on the fast speed before knocking up late when fifth over 1150m at Illawarra Grange. Proven second up and will appreciate the extra journey.
